blocks.text: LOS ANGELES–Quentin Grimes scored a career-high 47 points and forced overtime on his 10th 3-pointer with 1.7 seconds left in regulation before the Los Angeles Lakers finished off their ninth consecutive victory, 118-114 over the Charlotte Hornets in the NBA on Tuesday night. Luka Doncic had 36 points and seven assists for the Lakers, who trailed by 18 in the second half before roaring back to remain unbeaten in November despite playing without injured Austin Reaves and Walker Kessler.
